column1: # classifier_words.tsv — 量詞/常用名詞疊字表達「每一個/全部」變調 (reduplicated
# classifier "every X" tone sandhi) 觸發字白名單。
# When one of these single characters is immediately reduplicated (XX), the
# second copy is read with its tone brightened to 陰上 (tone 2) — 個個 (go3
# go3 -> go3 go2), 日日 (jat6 jat6 -> jat6 jat2), 人人 (jan4 jan4 -> jan4
# jan2). Each character's own citation tone is read normally from
# word.bin/char.bin at runtime — this file stores ONLY the whitelist
# (one character per line), never a reading, so it can't drift out of sync.
# This is a deliberately small pilot list of characters with a well-attested
# real "every X" reduplicated usage — reduplication alone is NOT enough
# signal (剛剛 "just now", 常常 "often" reduplicate without this shift), so
# only add a character here with a genuine spoken example, not by analogy.
# Format: one character per line. Blank lines and lines starting with '#'
# are ignored.
個
條
隻
件
樣
日
次
度
人
